name: honeycomb-hero
title: Honeycomb Hero
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A nature or travel hero: a light headline over a bold, tracked accent word, and a honeycomb of five hexagonal photographs with a hexagonal call to action set among them. A row of social links runs along the foot.
docs: Named export: HoneycombHero. Pass `title` and `titleAccent`, `subtitle`, `primaryActionLabel`/`primaryActionHref`, five `images` ({ src, alt }: large left, top centre, middle right, bottom left, bottom right) and `socialLinks`. `color` is a preset name or any CSS colour; `linkComponent` takes next/link.
